findings.criterion: COR-02/COR-03 untrusted data cannot terminate the global scheduler
findings.evidence: packages/core/src/orchestration.ts:79 — initial tick propagated errors across all plans and sources; apps/control-api/src/server.ts:167 shuts down admission after scheduler rejection. Initial proposalFromTask catch omitted NOT_FOUND; dependencyInput overflow escaped launch catch.
findings.counterargument: Strict input schemas and 8192-byte child input cap reject malformed or oversized requests.
findings.refutation: A schema-valid same-scope proposal can name a nonexistent profile/preparation, and bounded valid dependency output plus static input can exceed the child byte cap. Both are normal untrusted-data outcomes, not infrastructure failures.
findings.suggestion: Treat invalid source references as inert proposals and fail only the dependent plan on assembled-input overflow.
findings.remediation_status: Draft fix inspected: orchestration-plans.ts:85 catches domain 4xx, orchestration-scheduler.ts:75 catches dependency-input domain 4xx. Independent overflow probe passed. Final freeze/test reinspection still required.

findings.criterion: COR-03/COR-04 exact parent authority at final logical publication
findings.evidence: packages/core/src/agents-execution.ts:106 and packages/core/src/coding-execution.ts:143 initially tested parent expiry before multiple awaited operations; closing read-only validateLease at agents-execution.ts:117 and coding-execution.ts:192 intentionally skips parent authority.
findings.counterargument: The whole observation occurs under the serialized write lock and normal mutation checks parent authority.
findings.refutation: The lock excludes concurrent mutations but does not stop wall-clock expiry. A read-only result can cross the parent's shorter deadline during awaited transaction operations while its own task/lease deadlines remain valid. Physical cleanup may settle, but parent-expired logical success must be masked.
findings.suggestion: Recheck parent at closing publication; mask revoked success/output while preserving physical cleanup settlement.
findings.remediation_status: Backend began adding closing checks at agents-execution.ts:146 and coding-execution.ts:197 during review. Not yet reviewed or probed on frozen source; initial blocking verdict retained until explicit follow-up.
